fusions.name: Sore-Headed Thrust
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 24 piercing damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already lost, up to 30%. Usable only on a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Haft Swipe
fusions.desc: Swipes the haft around you, dealing 4 blunt damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Come at the Spear
fusions.desc: Plants the butt of the haft and pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathering Heft
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
